name: std::swap(std::valarray)

declarations.code:
template <class T>

void swap(std::valarray<T> &lhs, std::valarray<T> &rhs) noexcept;

intro: Specializes the std::swap algorithm for std::valarray. Swaps the contents of lhs and rhs. Calls lhs.swap(rhs).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
